verdict.rationale: A probe reports that Groq documents an official MCP server at console.groq.com/docs/mcp, so the product appears to offer this capability itself, but the evidence is a single thin mention. The remote-MCP docs describe Groq acting as an MCP client that consumes external servers, which is a different capability and is not credited here. Missing for 10: details of the MCP server's tools and capabilities, setup and authentication docs for connecting an agent, transport details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://console.groq.com/docs/mcp
